title: Dispatch stand-in: shared workforce vs oldest-first

comparison.label: Average priority score of planned jobs
Average days waiting of planned jobs

loop.setting: Distance penalty (points lost per km from the crew's first job)
loop.qualityFormula: Plan quality = total priority points planned - 0.2 x total km driven

limits: Workforce headcount is a SIMULATED PLACEHOLDER (default 100), not real City staffing.
A deployable crew is 5 people; each does up to 5 jobs a day.
crew_pool on tickets is service-area metadata only — it does not limit which crew can take a job.
Distances are straight lines between stops, not driving routes.
Priority scores come from the team scorer (scoring/priority_score.py), measured on Oct 2, 2026.
